kiel-fjord-laboe-hohwacht-lakes-loop.story: Baltic water first, Holstein bends later, no ferry gambling. The best part sits around Laboe memorial view, Schönberg coast road, Hohwacht bay stop, while Lütjenburg old-road reset keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.
